arxiv-2003-08634.title: A public key cryptography using multinacci block matrices
arxiv-2003-08634.creator: Munesh Kumari ID, Jagmohan Tanti ID
arxiv-2003-08634.description: Abstract In this paper, we have proposed a public key cryptography using recursive block matrices involving generalized Fibonacci numbers over a ﬁnite ﬁeld 𝔽 p \mathbb{F}_{p} . For this, we define multinacci block matrices, a type of upper triangular matrix involving multinacci matrices at diagonal places and obtained some of its algebraic properties.

arxiv-2004-02077.title: Machine Translation Pre-training for Data-to-Text Generation - A Case Study in Czech
arxiv-2004-02077.creator: Mihir Kale, Scott Roy
arxiv-2004-02077.description: Abstract While there is a large body of research studying deep learning methods for text generation from structured data, almost all of it focuses purely on English. In this paper, we study the effectiveness of machine translation based pre-training for data-to-text generation in non-English languages.

arxiv-2012-04636.title: Redshift-Space Distortions in Lagrangian Perturbation Theory
arxiv-2012-04636.creator: Martin White
arxiv-2012-04636.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Martin White. We present the one-loop 2-point function of biased tracers in redshift space computed with Lagrangian perturbation theory, including a full resummation of both long-wavelength (infrared) displacements and associated velocities. The resulting model accurately predicts the power spectrum and correlation function of halos and mock galaxies from two different sets of N-body simulations at the percent level for quasi-linear scales, including the damping of the baryon acoustic oscillation signal due to the bulk motions of galaxies.

arxiv-2104-12819.title: Extreme adaptive optics astrometry of R136 Thanks: Catalogue of reliable-consistent sources is only available in electronic form at the CDS via http://cdsweb.u-strasbg.fr/cgi-bin/qcat?J/A+A/ Thanks: Based on observations made with ESO Telescopes at the La Silla Paranal Observatory under programme ID
arxiv-2104-12819.creator: Z. Khorrami, M. Langlois, F. Vakili, P. C. Clark, A. S. M. Buckner, M. Gonzalez, P. Crowther, R. Wünsch, J. Palouš, A. Boccaletti, S. Lumsden, E. Moraux
arxiv-2104-12819.description: Abstract We compared high-contrast near-infrared images of the core of R136 taken by VLT/SPHERE, in two epochs separated by 3.06 years. For the first time we monitored the dynamics of the detected sources in the core of R136 from a ground-based telescope with adaptive optics.

arxiv-2106-08528.title: Spin-Torque-driven Terahertz Auto Oscillations in Non-Collinear Coplanar Antiferromagnets
arxiv-2106-08528.creator: Ankit Shukla, Shaloo Rakheja
arxiv-2106-08528.description: Abstract We theoretically and numerically study the terahertz auto oscillations, or self oscillations, in thin-film metallic non-collinear coplanar antiferromagnets (AFMs), such as Mn 3 ​ Sn \mathrm{Mn_{3}Sn} and Mn 3 ​ Ir \mathrm{Mn_{3}Ir} , under the effect of antidamping spin torque with spin polarization perpendicular to the plane of the film.

The work of MW is partially supported by the AFOSR under Award NO: FA9550-1
arxiv-2106-13289.creator: Harbir Antil, Thomas S. Brown, Ratna Khatri, Akwum Onwunta, Deepanshu Verma, Mahamadi Warma
arxiv-2106-13289.description: Abstract . This article provides a brief review of recent developments on two nonlocal operators: fractional Laplacian and fractional time derivative. We start by accounting for several applications of these operators in imaging science, geophysics, harmonic maps and deep (machine) learning.

arxiv-2206-02190.title: Bounds for the Bergman kernel and the sup-norm of holomorphic Siegel cusp forms
arxiv-2206-02190.creator: Soumya Das, Hariram Krishna
arxiv-2206-02190.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Soumya Das, Hariram Krishna. We prove ‘polynomial in k k ’ bounds on the size of the Bergman kernel for the space of holomorphic Siegel cusp forms of degree n n and weight k k . When n = 1 , 2 n=1,2 our bounds agree with the conjectural bounds on the aforementioned size, while the lower bounds match for all n ≥ 1 n\geq 1 .

arxiv-2307-16168.title: Credible intervals and bootstrap confidence intervals in monotone regression
arxiv-2307-16168.creator: Piet Groeneboom and Geurt Jongbloed
arxiv-2307-16168.description: Abstract In the recent paper [ 5 ] , a Bayesian approach for constructing confidence intervals in monotone regression problems is proposed, based on credible intervals. We view this method from a frequentist point of view, and show that it corresponds to a percentile bootstrap method of which we give two versions.

arxiv-2409-18817.title: Facility Location Problem with Aleatory Agents
arxiv-2409-18817.creator: Gennaro Auricchio, Jie Zhang
arxiv-2409-18817.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce and study the Facility Location Problem with Aleatory Agents (FLPAA), where the facility can accommodate a number of agents, namely n n , which is larger than the number of agents reporting their preferences, namely n r n_{r} .

arxiv-2410-16848.title: ETHIC : Evaluating Large Language Models on Long-Context Tasks with High Information Coverage
arxiv-2410-16848.creator: Taewhoo Lee, Chanwoong Yoon, Kyochul Jang, Donghyeon Lee, Minju Song, Hyunjae Kim, Jaewoo Kang
arxiv-2410-16848.description: Abstract Recent advancements in large language models (LLM) capable of processing extremely long texts highlight the need for a dedicated evaluation benchmark to assess their long-context capabilities. However, existing methods, like the needle-in-a-haystack test, do not effectively assess whether these models fully utilize contextual information, raising concerns about the reliability of current evaluation techniques.

arxiv-2505-15666.title: Shubnikov-de Haas Oscillations in 2D PtSe 2 \text{PtSe}_{2} : A fermiological Charge Carrier Investigation
arxiv-2505-15666.creator: Julian Max Salchegger, Rajdeep Adhikari, Bogdan Faina, Alberta Bonanni
arxiv-2505-15666.description: Abstract High magnetic field and low temperature transport is carried out in order to characterize the charge carriers of PtSe 2 \text{PtSe}_{2} . In particular, the Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations arising at applied magnetic field strengths ≳ 4.5 ​ T \gtrsim 4.

arxiv-2506-22160.title: Collective oscillations in the finite-size Kuramoto model below the critical coupling: shot-noise approach
arxiv-2506-22160.creator: S. Yu. Kirillov, V. V. Klinshov
arxiv-2506-22160.description: Abstract The Kuramoto model, a paradigmatic framework for studying synchronization, exhibits a transition to collective oscillations only above a critical coupling strength in the thermodynamic limit. However, real-world systems are finite, and their dynamics can deviate significantly from mean-field predictions. Here, we investigate finite-size effects in the Kuramoto model below the critical coupling, where the infinite-size theory predicts complete asynchrony.

arxiv-2510-08640.title: Automating Android Build Repair: Bridging the Reasoning-Execution Gap in LLM Agents with Domain-Specific Tools
arxiv-2510-08640.creator: Ha Min Son 1,2 Huan Ren 2 Xin Liu 1 Zhe Zhao 1,* 1 Department of Computer Science, University of Califnia, Davis 2 CodeDroid LLC
arxiv-2510-08640.description: Abstract Android is the largest mobile platform, yet automatically building applications remains a practical challenge. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for code repair, their use for fixing Android build errors remains underexplored. To address this gap, we first introduce AndroidBuildBench, a benchmark of 1,019 build failures curated from the commit histories of 43 open-source Android projects.

arxiv-2512-20622.title: How Feasible are Passive Network Attacks on 5G Networks and Beyond? A Survey
arxiv-2512-20622.creator: Atmane Ayoub Mansour Bahar, , Andrés Alayón Glazunov, , Romaric Duvignau
arxiv-2512-20622.description: Abstract Privacy concerns around 5G, the latest generation of mobile networks, are growing, with fears that its deployment may increase exposure to privacy risks. This perception is largely driven by the use of denser deployments of small antenna systems, which enable highly accurate data collection at higher speeds and closer proximity to mobile users.

Recently, the regulatory role of m6A in tumorigenesis has been increasingly recognized.

pmc-10535645.title: Kinematic Gait Analysis in People with Mild-Disability Multiple Sclerosis Using Statistical Parametric Mapping: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-10535645.creator: Diego Fernández-Vázquez, Gabriela Calvo-Malón, Francisco Molina-Rueda, Raúl López-González, María Carratalá-Tejada, Víctor Navarro-López, Juan Carlos Miangolarra-Page, Emiliano Schena
pmc-10535645.description: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic autoimmune disease that affects the central nervous system. Gait abnormalities, such as altered joint kinematics, are common in people with MS (pwMS). Traditional clinical gait assessments may not detect subtle kinematic alterations, but advances in motion capture technology and analysis methods, such as statistical parametric mapping (SPM), offer more detailed assessments.

pmc-10735553.title: IMPROVING LONGITUDINAL STUDIES OF AGING IN GEOSPATIAL HEALTH: AN AGENDA
pmc-10735553.creator: Michael Desjardins, Kyle Moored, Emily Murray, Gergő Baranyi, Matthew Hobbs, Sarah Curtis, Michelle Carlson
pmc-10735553.description: Recent decades have seen a vast demographic shift in ageing populations worldwide, where over 1.4 billion people will be aged 60 years and older by 2030. Given specific populations may be more vulnerable to medical conditions with ageing, identifying high-risk locations are essential for allocating resources and promoting healthy ageing to mitigate population-level financial- and health-associated burdens.

pmc-11448298.title: Motivational and emotional correlates of physical activity and sedentary behavior after cardiac rehabilitation: an observational study
pmc-11448298.creator: Layan Fessler, Elena Tessitore, Cecilia Craviari, Philippe Sarrazin, Philippe Meyer, Christophe Luthy, Eliana Hanna-Deschamps, Boris Cheval

pmc-12415790.title: Early follow-up blood cultures—frequency and outcomes of repeat blood culture collection within 48 hours of emergency department workup: an observational study
pmc-12415790.creator: Angela Zara Hills, Jaimi Greenslade, Mercedes Ray, Julian Williams
pmc-12415790.description: Objective:To determine the frequency and outcomes of early follow-up blood cultures (BCs) collected within 48 hours of patients being investigated for bacteremia in the emergency department (ED), as well as the number of new pathogens isolated.Design:Retrospective observational study of patients who had BCs collected in the ED between October 2019 and July 2020.

pmc-12472577.title: Trimetazidine–Profen Hybrid Molecules: Synthesis, Chemical Characterization, and Biological Evaluation of Their Racemates
pmc-12472577.creator: Diyana Dimitrova, Stanimir Manolov, Iliyan Ivanov, Dimitar Bojilov, Nikol Dimova, Gabriel Marc, Smaranda Oniga, Ovidiu Oniga, Liqiang Chen
pmc-12472577.description: Background: Trimetazidine is a clinically established cardioprotective agent with anti-ischemic and antioxidant properties, widely used in the management of coronary artery disease. Combining its metabolic and cytoprotective effects with the potent anti-inflammatory activity of profens presents a promising therapeutic strategy. Methods: Five novel trimetazidine–profen hybrid compounds were synthesized using N,N′-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide-mediated coupling and structurally characterized by NMR and high-resolution mass spectrometry.

pmc-13065965.title: The effect of resiquimod (a Toll-like receptor-7/8 agonist) on the balance between pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory cytokines in breast cancer patients
pmc-13065965.creator: Eman ElAlfy, Lobna A. Abou-Shamaa, Soheir Rizk Demian, Eman M Osman, Yasmine ELwany, Marwa Mohamed Samak
pmc-13065965.description: BackgroundBreast cancer (BC) progression is influenced by both pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines. Interleukin (IL)-12 and IL-35 play opposing immunological roles, functioning as pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines with anti- and pro-tumorigenic effects, respectively. Resiquimod (RSQ), a Toll-like receptor 7/8 (TLR7/8) agonist, is an immunomodulatory agent that enhances antitumor immune responses.

pmc-13208795.title: Contralateral Recurrence and Temporal Trend After First Side Surgery for Primary Spontaneous Pneumothorax: A Multicenter Analysis
pmc-13208795.creator: Antonio Giulio Napolitano, Dania Nachira, Gloria Santoro, Eleonora Coviello, Maria Teresa Congedo, Marco Sanguigni, Domenico Pourmolkara, Chiara Scognamiglio, Leonardo Petracca Ciavarella, Adriana Nocera, Maria Letizia Vita, Felice Mucilli, Jacopo Vannucci, Elisa Meacci, Francesco Puma, Filippo Loco
pmc-13208795.description: Background: Contralateral recurrence following surgically treated primary spontaneous pneumothorax represents clinical concern yet remains poorly understood. This study aims to expand the current understanding by evaluating a large, multicenter cohort over a 10-year period and to determine the true incidence of contralateral recurrence assessing the potential role of clinical factors in risk stratification.

pmc-13218264.title: Fucosterol from marine algae: a multifunctional marine phytosterol with health benefits-from dietary component to functional ingredient
pmc-13218264.creator: Shasha Guo, Xiaochun Liu, Yanchun Gao, Fangxue Xu, Xiaozhi Xi
pmc-13218264.description: Fucosterol is the predominant sterol in brown algae, exhibits multiple bioactivities relevant to human health, including regulation of lipid metabolism, improvement of insulin resistance, as well as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, neuroprotective, and antitumor effects. These effects are primarily mediated through the modulation of key metabolic and inflammatory signaling pathways, including LXR, PPARγ, and NF-κB. However, its high hydrophobicity (LogP≈7.

pmc-13571664.title: Gastrointestinal parasite assemblages in wild mammals from two forest localities in Gabon
pmc-13571664.creator: Patrice Makouloutou-Nzassi, Fatim Tine, Arfang Diamanka, Judi Armel Bourobou Bourobou, Neil Michel Longo-Pendy, Paul Yannick Bitome Essono, Félicien Bangueboussa, Rodrigue Mintsa-Nguema, Larson Boundenga
pmc-13571664.description: Gastrointestinal parasite assemblages are influenced by host compatibility, exposure, behavior, and environmental conditions; however, baseline data remain limited in Central Africa. We characterized gastrointestinal parasite morphotypes in 279 fecal samples collected from five wild mammal taxa at Lopé National Park and Makatamangoye, Gabon. Parasites were identified using flotation and sedimentation techniques and classified to the lowest morphologically defensible taxonomic level.

uslaw-usc-t7-s1635e.title: 7 U.S.C. § 1635e — Mandatory reporting for live cattle
uslaw-usc-t7-s1635e.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s1635e.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 38 (Distribution And Marketing Of Agricultural Products); Subchapter II (Livestock Mandatory Reporting); Part B (Cattle Reporting). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment The Secretary shall establish a program of live cattle price information reporting that will— (1) provide timely, accurate, and reliable market information; (2) facilitate more informed marketing decisions; and (3) promote competition.
